positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop software applications using C#, NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, React, TypeScript, SQL Server, and Azure cloud services such as App Service, SQL Server, Redis, Service Bus, Blob Storage, Key Vault, AKS, and CosmoDb NoSql.
- Work closely with stakeholders to set technical directions and architectural designs, provide estimates, and create product backlog items.
- Do researches and POCs to help make important technical decisions.
- Create documentations, technical diagrams, and development guidelines for projects.
- Mentor junior developers.
positions.insights: Software Design, Enterprise Software and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implement new features, enhancements, and customer wishes for multiple products developed using different frameworks and technologies such as ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, Web API, AngularJS, BootStrap, Visual C++ MFC and .NET Windows Forms, . 

- Resolve bugs and issues in existing Web, Desktop, and Windows Service applications.

- Work closely with Senior Software Engineers to develop new products using Microsoft technologies.
